title: MELSEC iQ-F (FX5)
summary: Compact Mitsubishi controllers with expansion modules; X/Y devices numbered in octal.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: An FX5 CPU module carries integrated I/O; expansion modules are added on the right and continue the X/Y numbering.

sections.heading: In PLC Lab
sections.body: Tier B knowledge profile: addresses are shown as octal X/Y devices. **SIMULATION APPROXIMATION** of presentation only.

simulation.displayName: Mitsubishi MELSEC iQ-F FX5 (PLC Lab knowledge profile)

modeled: Cyclic scan with input image, transactional program execution and output update
Configured versus installed modules, module status LEDs and diagnostic buffer events
Digital and analog channel behavior including wire break and over/underrange
approximated: Octal X/Y device numbering is presented; analog uses the PLC Lab 0..10000 convention
omitted: Vendor firmware, memory model, task model and instruction set
Online editing, retentive memory and multiple tasks
